# container.Base#insert cannot park a lazy module config; a dock pane resolved lazily throws in the projection swap

Sub-issue of #13158. The tab-flow twin of #18062 (a rail loads a lazy module item on reveal): found by the Fleet cockpit's bootstrap CTA on the engine pin that carries #18063 (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#74 / PR #77), reproduced live through the Neural Link on 2026-09-02 13:0xZ.

## Context

A tab container accepts a lazy card — `{module: () => import('...')}` — and loads it when the card becomes active (`layout.Card#afterSetActiveIndex` → `loadModule`). Construction supports it end to end: `container.Base#createItem` parks a lazy config (it stays a plain object and gets `vdom: {removeDom: true}`, `Base.mjs:449-466`), `createItems` pushes that placeholder vnode into the items root so indices stay aligned (`:516-528`), and `loadModule` later replaces `items[index]` and `cn[index]` with the created instance (`layout/Card.mjs:~180`).

`container.Base#insert` (`Base.mjs:~670-720`) does not: after `item = me.createItem(item, index, …)` it unconditionally runs `me.layout?.applyChildAttributes(item, index, true)` and `item.createVdomReference()` — a parked config has neither a `vdom` the layout can mark nor a `createVdomReference` method, so `insert` throws (`TypeError: item.createVdomReference is not a function`, the same throw #18062 met on the reveal slot). `add()` is `insert(getCount(), item)`, so both entry points reject a lazy config.

## The Problem

The dock projection materializes panes through `insert`. `Workspace#refreshDockWorkspace` builds the projection with geometry-equivalent placeholders (`createProjectionPlaceholder`: a hidden `Component` per item), and `Reconciler.reconcileProjection` then swaps each placeholder for the resolved pane: `targetBody.insert(targetIndex, pane, true)` (`Reconciler.mjs:696`, again at `:727` for moves). When `resolvePane` returns a lazy config, that `insert` throws inside the reconciler; the refresh chain rejects (observable only on its own `refreshPromise` snapshot — nothing reaches the console), and the DOM keeps the projected tab node with an orphaned placeholder body.

Live read on the Fleet cockpit at engine `961ac9cd11` (which carries #18063): calling the bootstrap CTA's handler (`onAddAgentRequest` → `setItemAutoHidden(defineAgent, false)`) projects the `secondary-rail` tabs node with the header `Add agent` active and ONE card, `neo-component-184` — a bare `Neo.component.Base`, 0 children, 128×259, invisible; the instance is already gone worker-side (`get_instance_properties` → not found), the DOM node stayed. `.fm-add-agent-form` never appears — the red `AddAgentJourneyNL` carries on the second pin. The rail path (a click on the `Add agent` rail tab) renders the form, because the rail loads the module itself before adding (#18062); the tab path has no such loader and relies on `insert`.

Every consumer that resolves a pane lazily and lets the projection place it into the tab flow (un-hide, pin, a perspective that re-projects a lazily resolved item) hits this. The Workstation and the dock example resolve eagerly, so they never did.

## The Architectural Reality

- `container.Base#createItem` (`:392-470`): the `'Object'` case detects `lazyLoadItem = module && !module.isClass && Neo.isFunction(module)`, skips `Neo.create`, and stamps `item.vdom = {removeDom: true}` — the parked shape. (Two detection spellings exist at `:442` and `:984`; `layout.Card` uses `Neo.typeOf(module) === 'Function'` — the operator's preferred idiom, adopted in #18063.)
- `container.Base#createItems` (`:516-528`): `item instanceof Neo.core.Base ? (layout.applyChildAttributes + createVdomReference) : item.vdom` — the construction-time contract `insert` must mirror.
- `layout.Card#afterSetActiveIndex` (`Card.mjs:85-140`): loads the lazy config at the active index; `loadModule(item, index)` awaits the import, `Neo.create`s the instance, applies child attributes, replaces `cn[index]` with the reference and fires `cardLoaded`. It runs on `activeIndex` CHANGE — a lazy config inserted at the already-active index after construction is never loaded unless the inserter asks.
- `Reconciler.reconcileProjection` (`Reconciler.mjs:690-730`): reads `inserted.header` for the tab button config right after the insert — a parked config carries `header` (the adapter's `decorateItemConfig` stamps it), so a parked return value satisfies that read.

## The Fix

`src/container/Base.mjs#insert` learns the parked branch that `createItems` already has:

1. After `createItem`, if the result is not a `Neo.core.Base` (a parked lazy config): skip `applyChildAttributes`, splice the config into `items`, splice `item.vdom` (the `{removeDom: true}` placeholder) into the items root at `index` — indices stay aligned for `loadModule`'s later `cn[index]` replacement.
2. If the container's layout can load cards and `index` is its active index, start the load now: `me.layout.loadModule(item, index)` followed by a container update when it settles — the layout's activation hook will not fire for an index that is already active. A non-active parked card stays parked and loads on activation, as at construction.
3. `insert` returns the parked config in that case (the caller's `header` read holds); the `insert` event still fires after the update.
4. JSDoc on `insert` states the parked contract (Anchor & Echo); `container.Base#createItem` / `:984` keep their detection (a follow-up may unify on `Neo.typeOf`).

No change in the reconciler or the dock host: the projection's swap is exactly `insert`, and the tab container's card layout owns activation — the semantics the operator described for tab containers (static or dynamic imports per card) apply to a projected dock pane unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit (`test/playwright/unit/container/`): `insert(0, {module: () => import(...)})` into a card-layout container parks the config (`items[0]` is the config, the items root holds a `removeDom` placeholder at 0), throws nothing, and — the index being active — resolves to the created instance after the import (`items[0] instanceof <class>`, `cn[0]` its reference); inserted at a non-active index it stays parked until activation. Red on `dev` (`TypeError: item.createVdomReference is not a function`).
- [ ] Component (`test/playwright/component/dashboard/`, on the `dock-lazy-rail` fixture): committing `setItemAutoHidden(lazy, false)` through the workspace projects the lazy item into the tab flow and renders `.dock-lazy-rail-pane` inside a visible card, one construction; the rail arms stay green. Red on `dev` (the placeholder body stays, no pane).
- [ ] `unit/container`, `unit/layout`, `unit/dashboard` and `component/dashboard` green.
- [ ] Post-merge: neomjs/neo-agent-institution PR #77 bumps to the pin that carries this; `AddAgentJourneyNL` green under the Brain root (the CTA path).
